bitrate.instructions: Choose the next video chunk bitrate to maximize long-run streaming quality of experience. Each chunk reward is bitrate_Mbps minus 4.3 times rebuffer_seconds minus the absolute bitrate change in Mbps. Chunks last 4 seconds. Use the measured throughput history, buffer and candidate chunk sizes to balance quality, rebuffering and quality changes. Future network bandwidth is unknown. Select exactly one available bitrate. Candidate est_download_s uses the harmonic mean of the last five measured effective throughputs, not future bandwidth. est_buffer_margin_s is current buffer minus estimated download time; a negative value indicates estimated stall. switch_cost_qoe is the absolute bitrate change in Mbps. Estimates may be wrong; consider network history.
